title: The Toxic Spill
logline: A scientist accidentally spills an experimental terraforming catalyst in a docking bay, mutating the local mold, and needs a pilot to quietly clean it up before the dockmaster finds out.

roles.description: Scatterbrained, deeply embarrassed, trying to hide their mistake.
Obsessed with cleanliness, yells at anyone tracking dirt.
A dark cargo bay currently overflowing with rapidly growing purple mold.

public_situation: The {role:contaminated_bay} has been sealed off due to a 'minor plumbing issue'.
private_truth: The scientist dropped a vial of illegal terraforming catalyst. The mold is now highly aggressive and eating the station's hull plating.

beats.public_change: Strange scratching noises are heard coming from the sealed bay.

missions.reason: The scientist begs the pilot to meet a bribed janitor near the bay and collect a sample of the mold so they can synthesize a cure.
missions.private_fact: The mold has already eaten the scientist's dropped commlink and is broadcasting static.

beats.public_change: The dockmaster notices a purple stain spreading into the main concourse.

missions.reason: The dockmaster hires the pilot to scan the bay to figure out what the smell is.
missions.private_fact: The pilot's scan reveals the mold is highly corrosive and spreading fast.

beats.public_change: The mold breaches the ventilation system.

missions.reason: The scientist asks the pilot to deliver a tank of neutralizing acid to the bay to dissolve the mold.
missions.private_fact: The acid works, but leaves a massive, unexplainable hole in the deck plating.

player_choice.prompt: The bay is clean, but the scientist's reputation is on the line.

options.label: Report the scientist to the dockmaster
Keep the secret and claim it was a pipe burst

resolutions.summary: The dockmaster fines the scientist into oblivion. The station is safe, but the scientist's career is ruined.
The dockmaster yells at the janitors for a pipe burst. The scientist pays the pilot well and keeps their job.
The mold eats through the docking bay seals, causing an explosive decompression that vents the bay into space.

loose_threads.detail: The catalyst vial has the logo of a terraforming company that went bankrupt thirty years ago.
The mold seems to be deliberately growing toward the station's main communication array.

voice_direction.angry_dockmaster: Loud, booming, deeply annoyed by everything.
